reason: Alpaca internal errors persist even for six bars. Test different hypotheses on accessible long daily histories instead of repeatedly retrying the failed connector or altering the rejected intraday strategy.
economic_hypotheses: Overnight index return compensates investors for inventory and information risk; test whether trading only overnight is worth round-trip costs.
Persistent trends and changing volatility may support lower-turnover exposure management; this is a comparator, not a claim that timing is inherently alpha.
data: Yahoo daily OHLC, adjusted close, splits and dividends, requested with explicit timestamps and verified granularity. Dates 2010-01-01 to 2026-09-08 exclusive. Use 2011-2025 for evaluation, 2011-2021 development diagnostic, 2022-2025 reserved chronological evaluation. Do not change parameters after results. Preserve raw provider responses and hashes. Prices/returns adjusted for distributions; reconstruct historical nominal share prices from future split ratios if needed, otherwise label notional approximation.
overnight: For each QQQ->QLD and SPY->SSO mapping independently, buy at the official closing price and sell at next session opening price; no intraday stop can protect an overnight gap. Cases always and base-index above lagged 200-day simple moving average. Position capped at 50% equity in purchased ETF, whole shares. Signal for closing purchase uses prior session's close, not the execution close. No parameter optimization. Cost scenarios 0,2,5,10 bps round trip, applied to traded notional.
trend_comparator: For each same mapping, observe previous-session base-index close versus its 200-day SMA. Trade at next open; if on, target 50% ETF notional; if off, cash. Rebalance only on state changes. Additional fixed variant targets 18% annualized equity volatility using ETF prior 60 close-to-close daily returns, caps ETF weight at 100%, changes weight only on first session each month or state changes. Per-side costs 0,1,2.5,5 bps, comparable to round-trip scenarios. No margin borrowing. Whole shares and actual embedded-leverage ETFs.
benchmarks: Buy-and-hold SPY and QQQ over each matching evaluation period with dividends; zero-interest cash baseline. All tests pretax; no subscription cost; actual fund returns incorporate their expenses. Compare both CAGR and drawdown, plus market exposure, to avoid labeling a Nasdaq tilt or higher exposure as alpha.
statistics: Full interval, per-year and development/reserved splits. Five-session block bootstrap on net daily returns with zero-return inactive days retained. Report every declared variant; no selection on reserved performance then claim an untouched test. Overnight risk measured at open/close understates within-session risk and historical fills at auction not guaranteed.
implementation_gate: Potential candidate must have positive net reserved performance at 5 and 10 bps, economically useful return and drawdown consistent with 25% tolerance. Positive results are historical evidence only, not live alpha proof. If no candidate meets the gate, report failure and do not force a winning variant.
